Subject: RE: SDK integration kickoff — Implementation prep

Team — forwarding Leah's note and the initial checklist. High level implementation playbook (draft) below — please annotate and I'll send the finalized toolkit to SaaSCo by end of day.

1) Sandbox provisioning (today)
- Create sandbox API key with region tags (us-west-2 primary), TTL 30d
- Upload sample dataset for smoke tests (small tokenized set)

2) SDK quickstart (deliverables)
- python_sample.py: basic auth + call pattern (synchronous and streaming)
- go_client_example: sample batch embeddings call + async polling
- curl snippet for quick smoke:
  curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
    -d '{"model": "open-embed-1", "input": ["hello"]}'

3) Recommended timeouts & retries
- Connection timeout: 200ms
- Read timeout: 2s for small payloads, up to 8s for batching windows
- Retries: client-side exponential backoff (base=200ms, multiplier=2, max_retries=3), jitter randomized
- Idempotency: ensure unique request id headers for non-idempotent operations

4) Rate limiting & throttling strategy
- Client-side token-bucket to smooth bursts (burst_capacity ~= 3x baseline QPS)
- Honor 429 responses: immediate short wait (Retry-After if present), else exponential backoff starting at 250ms
- Use adaptive batching for embeddings to reduce per-request cost; provide sample batching helper

5) Endpoint migration sequence (minimal downtime)
- Step A: Smoke test against sandbox endpoint (validate latency & success rate)
- Step B: Provision staging keys; run 5% traffic and monitor token-level latency & error budget for 4 hours
- Step C: Ramp 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 1-2 hour windows depending on error signals
- Step D: Final DNS cut with TTL=60s; keep canary fallback to older endpoint for 24h

6) Observability hooks (required by SaaSCo)
- Add X-Request-Id header to each call, send traces to their tracing backend (we'll supply tracing middleware)
- Include token-level latency dashboards and alert thresholds (p50/p95/p99)

Attachments we will upload to the shared Drive: sample-snippets.tar.gz (contains python_sample.py, go_client_example, batching_helper.py), migration scripts, and mutual-action-plan.docx.

Notes on edge cases: if customer needs private deployment checklist, mark as escalation; Vivek please prepare KMS/HSM and on-prem checklist items.

Action items:
- Vanessa: propose two kickoff slots (30m) for next week for SaaSCo infra
- Monica: draft the mutual action plan and acceptance criteria
- Vivek: annotate the private deployment checklist if SaaSCo requests it

Mateo
